name: Frozen Heart
source:
When you set out on an adventure, you never know where you'll end up. Commander Angeline asked you to join her on the simple quest of acquiring a ship, but she didn't tell you she was hiding a secret.

Ever since her legendary sword, Sigard (which grants her the power of ice and cold), was repaired, she's been struggling attune with it. Is the sword resisting her? Has she changed since the Battle of Stars Reach or has the sword changed? Either way, if she can't regain control of the sword, the sword will take control of her.

A riddle left by the sword's former owner may be the clue to saving Angeline, but not only is the path dangerous, your enemies are following your every move.

For good or evil, fate is in your hands.

[From [url=https://dinmoney.itch.io/frozenheart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你踏上冒险之旅时，你永远不知道自己会在哪里结束。安吉琳指挥官邀请你和她一起完成获得一艘船的简单任务，但她没有告诉你她隐藏着一个秘密。

自从她的传奇之剑西加德（赋予她冰冷之力）被修复以来，她一直在努力适应它。剑在抵抗她吗？是星辰之战之后她变了，还是剑变了？不管怎样，如果她无法重新控制剑，剑就会控制她。

这把剑的前主人留下的谜语可能是拯救安洁琳特的线索，但道路不仅危险，你的敌人也在跟踪你的一举一动。

无论善恶，命运都掌握在你的手中。

[来自[url=https://dinmoney.itch.io/frozenheart]itch.io[/url]]
